title: Moving from Addis Ababa to Bishoftu or Sululta: Distance & Pricing Guide
excerpt: Long-distance moves from Addis to Bishoftu (~47 km southeast) or Sululta (~25–35 km north): pricing factors, timing, and what professional movers include.
content:
Greater Addis moves

Many families and businesses treat Bishoftu (lakeside, industrial growth) and Sululta (northern suburban corridor) as part of their relocation map—not a different country, but not a same-day Bole-to-Bole hop either. Active Movers plans these as distance moves with clear crew and travel time in the quote.

Typical distances

  • Bishoftu — often cited around 45–50 km southeast of central Addis, depending on origin.
  • Sululta — roughly 25–35 km north; exact time varies by sub-city start point and traffic.

What changes the price

Expect pricing to reflect road time, toll on crew hours, and access at both ends—not only bedroom count. Villa and compound moves, office equipment, and full packing add volume. Industry practice often adds roughly 15–25% over an equivalent in-city move for comparable homes, but your survey is the source of truth.

Direction matters

Southeast loads toward Bishoftu often leave via different outbound choke points than northern Sululta legs. Quote should show load hours in Addis, transit, and unload at destination separately—see long-distance overview.

Planning tips

  • Confirm truck can reach your destination compound—some phases use temporary access roads.
  • Align Addis load-out with Bishoftu/Sululta reception hours and building rules.
  • Label boxes by room; one truck load beats multiple shuttles when distance is involved.
  • Protect upholstery for highway vibration—packing materials.

Compare other legs

Adama (Nazret) is farther southeast; Hawassa is a full inter-city job. Pick the guide that matches your destination.

Same-day vs next-day unload
